description: This PHP file defines an abstract class RawPage within the Todaymade\Daux\Format\Base namespace. The class manages a filename property and provides methods to retrieve the filename and throw exceptions for content-related methods.

classes.name: RawPage
classes.description: An abstract class representing a raw page, implementing the Page interface, managing file information, and providing placeholder methods for content retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the RawPage with a filename.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with this page.

methods.name: getPureContent
methods.description: Throws an exception indicating that raw content should not be retrieved via this method.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Throws an exception indicating that raw content should not be retrieved via this method.
